title.en: Minimax H3, open weights, generated locally. A whole autumn on one leaf. It doesn't fall.
title.zh: Minimax H3, open weights, generated locally. A whole autumn on one leaf. It doesn't fall.

description.en: A source-verified MiniMax H3 cinematic story prompt with attached video evidence from @GlennHasABeard.
description.zh: 由原作者公开 X 帖提供并已核验视频结果的 MiniMax H3电影叙事提示词。

prompt:
"the green drains from the edges inward, yellow spreading, then orange creeping in from the veins, then deep red taking the whole leaf, then brown starting at the tip"

Duration: 15s. Camera: locked macro. Rendered locally in ComfyUI, then Topaz to 4K.

Colors in order, each with where it starts. That's a timeline. "Turns autumn colors" is a mood.
